title: Charge, Strangeness, Baryon Number
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the electric charge, strangeness, and baryon number of particle H.

title: Quark Count
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the correct number of quarks that particle H must contain.

title: Minimum Momentum Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the invariant mass formula to find the minimum incident beam proton momentum.

title: Decay Modes Discussion
description: Important Criteria: The student must discuss the possible decay modes of H, considering both strong and weak decays.

title: Energy Conservation Violation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention that certain strong decay channels are forbidden due to energy conservation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the momentum and energy calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent, particularly in energy and momentum calculations.
